2608.06112.title: From Siloed Algorithms to Compliance-First Agentic Platforms: A Multi-Layered Architecture for Hospital AI Systems
2608.06112.paper_summary: Hospitals are rapidly adopting artificial intelligence for triage, imaging, scheduling etc., yet most deployments remain isolated point solutions locked inside departmental silos, resulting in duplicated effort, hidden risks, and unrealized enterprise value. Despite explosive growth of AI in healthcare market and accelerating investment, an estimated 70-80% of healthcare AI pilots fail to scale, largely due to governance gaps, fragmented data, and missing integration blueprints. This research proposes a hospital-specific, compliance-first, Agentic AI architecture with multiple interoperable layers, extending existing hospital AI platform models with: (i) an Agent Orchestration Layer for multi-agent workflows across clinical, operational, and financial domains, (ii) a Compliance and Policy Layer that centralizes policy-as-code for HIPAA, GDPR, the EU AI Act, DISHA Act, India's DPDP Act, and ISO/IEC security and safety standards, and (iii) a Privacy-Preserving Data Fabric that plugs federated learning, differential privacy, and secure enclaves into real-world Hospital Information Management System (HIMS) flows. Using a synthetic but structurally realistic hospital dataset and an open, ready-to-deploy prototype implementation, this study demonstrates the end-to-end orchestration of triage risk prediction, workflow optimization, and compliance logging, achieving substantial simulated reductions in task turnaround times and manual documentation effort while maintaining policy-guarded data access. The resulting architecture offers hospital leaders a pragmatic blueprint to move from ad hoc tools to a governed, globally compliant, ROI-focused AI platform that can be tailored to on-premise, hybrid and cloud-native deployments.
2608.06112.paper_summary_zh: 醫院正在迅速採用人工智慧進行分診、影像處理、排程等工作，然而大多數的部署仍然是孤立的點解決方案，鎖定在部門的孤島中，導致重複的努力、隱藏的風險和未實現的企業價值。儘管醫療市場中的人工智慧增長迅猛且投資加速，但估計有70-80%的醫療人工智慧試點無法擴展，主要是由於治理缺口、數據碎片化和缺乏整合藍圖。本研究提出了一種針對醫院的、以合規為首的Agentic AI架構，具有多層可互操作性，擴展現有的醫院人工智慧平台模型，包括：(i) 用於臨床、運營和財務領域的多代理工作流程的代理編排層，(ii) 集中管理HIPAA、GDPR、歐盟人工智慧法案、DISHA法案、印度DPDP法案及ISO/IEC安全和安全標準的合規和政策層，以及(iii) 將聯邦學習、差分隱私和安全區域整合到現實世界醫院資訊管理系統（HIMS）流程中的隱私保護數據架構。利用一個合成但結構上現實的醫院數據集和一個開放的、隨時可部署的原型實現，本研究展示了分診風險預測、工作流程優化和合規記錄的端到端編排，實現了在任務周轉時間和手動文檔工作量方面的顯著模擬減少，同時保持政策保護的數據訪問。最終架構為醫院領導者提供了一個務實的藍圖，以便從臨時工具轉向一個受治理的、全球合規的、以投資回報為重點的人工智慧平台，該平台可以根據本地、混合和雲原生部署進行定制。
